items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Me and Louie and George used to play with Kit Harris.

ctx.x: He played just there. Kit Harris? Who was him? Huh? Kit Harris, I didn't know him. No, you didn't know Kit Harris? No, he did too, Kit Harris. Yeah, trumpet, yeah. Me and Louie and George used to play with Kit Harris. He's a good trampone player, Louie Nelson did.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: And then you remember Kit Harris?

ctx.x: Did you play with Jack any?

Huh? You played with Jack some time, huh? Jack? Oh yeah. Yeah, I remember his band when you remember. But you quit him and you taken all that from him, you see? And we went with you. And you know how the two down there was Linton come saying that's bad, well that's how it broke us up, you see? And then we got together and we worked with different other fellas. That's what broke his bad enough, you know? Yeah, I had a job in the country for Austin and Johnny Henry. And then it was Crowback. And he couldn't come to…
